SPECIFICATION FOR 
PITON HAMMERS FOR MOUNTAINEERING 



1- Scope — Lays down the requirements for piton hammers for mountaineering. 
2. Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1»

3. Material 



3.1 tfeacf an</ Locking Strip — Steel conforming to T50 of IS : 3749-1966 ' Specification for tool and die 
steels for cold work'. 

3.2 Handle — High or medium density wood-based laminates (compreg), conforming to Type V of 
IS: 3513 (Part III )-1966 'Specification for high and medium density wood-based laminates 
(compreg): Part III General purposes' or ash, which shall be of straight grain and well seasoned 
to a moisture content not exceeding 15 percent and not less than 10 percent, 

3.3 Rivets — Shall conform to IS: 2155-1962 'Specification for rivets for general engineering 
purposes 1 . 



3.4 Thong — Nylon tape with a minimum breaking strength of 1 900 N,

IS: 9248 -1979 

4. Hardness — The hammer head shall be evenly hardened and tempered and shall have hardness 
of 400 to 500 HV, at least up to 20 mm from the square working end and 40 mm from the pick working 
end. 

5. Mass — 675 g, Max. 

6. Workmanship and Finish — The head shall be soundly forged in one piece. The rivet holes 
shall be at right angle to growth rings. 

6.1 The handle blanks shall be quarter sawn and free from centre heart ( pith ) knots, shakes, curbs, 
rot checks, splits, warp, brashness, borer holes and discolouration owing to incipient decay. 

7. Marking — Each piton hammer shall be legibly and indelibly stamped or marked with the manu- 
facturer's name or recognized trade-mark. 

7-1 ISl Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard lays down requirements for piton hammers for mountaineering used for driving 
pitons in cracks and ice and to lever them out again. 

Although maximum mass of piton hammer has been laid down in the standard, every effort 
should be made to reduce the mass of the hammers without effecting its performance requirement. 



Printed at Neelkamat Printers, Delhi, India
